links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM-generated patient-friendly summaries of glaucoma clinic notes rated by ophthalmologists
links.effect: LLaMA 2 correctly summarized 97 notes (66%) in paragraph and 103 (70%) in bullet format; 44 (30%) and 41 (28%) partially correct. ChatGPT-4 46% correct paragraph, 50% bullet.
